messages:
meera: quick follow-up to the model-versioning RFC: propose adding a small set of rollout metadata fields to help the runtime make safe soft-evict decisions for sticky refs. thinking migration_score, stability_score, soft_ttl_seconds, grace_window_ms, and auto_evict.

jordan: +1. ranges and default semantics?

samir: propose 0-100 integer for both migration_score and stability_score. migration_score higher => more candidate for rollforward. stability_score reflects eval-derived quality (higher is better).

ophelia: ops: we need enterprise opt-out. add auto_evict boolean and soft_ttl_seconds to respect long lived sessions. default soft_ttl 3600s.

meera: sample payload (for readability only): { variant_id: "rw-7b-v4", migration_score: 60, stability_score: 90, soft_ttl_seconds: 3600, grace_window_ms: 30000, auto_evict: true, reason_short: "latency+memory wins", eval_ref: "evals/2026-03/promptset-12" }

jordan: define grace_window_ms?

meera: grace_window_ms = window to accept overlapping probes during a rollforward before enforcing strict selection. handles clock skew / queued requests. default 30s.

samir: runtime scoring suggestion: migration_priority = migration_score - (100 - stability_score). tie-break by canary_pct then last_updated_ts. will add tests.

ophelia: add client header Prefer-Stable:true to allow clients to require stability_score >= 80. also compact_hint header for mobile: "ms:60,ss:85,ttl:3600".

jordan: defaults: migration_score=50, stability_score=100 (for existing variants), soft_ttl_seconds=3600, grace_window_ms=30000, auto_evict=true.

ophelia: eviction backoff plan: offsets [0s,30s,2m,10m,1h] scaled by grace_window_ms/1000. include eviction_attempt_id in logs for SRE traceability.

infra-bot: note: autoscaler bumped pool-1 at 1789991250. no routing changes flagged. :white_check_mark:

meera: next steps: 1) add fields to rollout metadata schema. 2) append scoring + tie-breaks to RFC appendix. 3) Console add reason_short + eval_ref UI hooks. 4) docs for Prefer-Stable and compact_hint. ophelia to own enterprise playbook.

jordan: no blockers.

samir: will draft runtime patch and unit tests.

ophelia: will draft ops playbook and dashboard tile for migration_priority.

meera: if no objections by EOD I'll merge this as RFC appendix. thanks :thumbsup:
